# Astronomical 0.2.46
Stable, signed, notarized macOS (Apple silicon) release.
## Changes since 0.2.45
- Laguna accepts OpenAI-style thinking levels: a client-selected `reasoning_effort` now prepares a chat instead of failing with `positive thinking budgets are not supported by Laguna generation`. Thinking stays template-driven with no token ceiling on this family (#703, #704). - The MTP decode head remains eligible for requests while the persistent prompt cache is available, so prompt-cache users keep MTP decode acceleration (#701). - Download catalog adds Jundot/Qwen3.8-27B-oQ4e-mtp. - Documentation: repository discovery guide refreshed to the 0.2.45 release state (#702); Laguna thinking-budget contract and release-verification lessons recorded (#706).
## Compatibility
- REST surface and configuration schema unchanged; existing configuration, model downloads, and prompt caches carry over.
## Distribution
Developer ID signed with Hardened Runtime, notarized and stapled, Sparkle Ed25519 signed feed. Every release artifact is digest-bound to `release-manifest.json`.
